App Pro Help

Start a block on January 4

Choose your workouts now. Start your training block on Monday, January 4, 2027.

Training blocks need Pro

Set up your weeks

  1. Open Plan > New block. Choose a program or use your own workouts.
  2. Set January 4 as the start, choose the length, and set your training days. Add a deload week if your plan calls for one.
  3. Review the block. Today shows the session to lift on each training day.

You can also ask the AI trainer (Pro, iOS 27) to build a program for your goal, schedule, and equipment. Review the workouts before you apply the program.

Choose a starting point

Block includes 17 programs for different schedules and equipment. Without Pro, a program starts as a folder of workouts. Edit the lifts, sets, and rest to suit your training.

Review the next session

With Pro on iOS 27, the AI trainer can propose each lift's next load and reps after a saved session. Approve or reject each line. The app does not change a load by itself.
